slides.body: Marketing lives on the front. Reality lives on the back. Flip any instant coffee jar. slides.heading: Pure coffee behaves differently in cold milk — no chicory bite
slides.body: Chicory turns harsh and astringent the moment it hits cold temperature. Pure freeze-dried coffee does not. Purista is pure Robusta granules — zero chicory. That granule was Purista from Purity Beans.

Freeze-drying locks volatile aromatics that spray-drying burns off. The result: a pure Robusta granule that delivers crema, body, and a clean, bold finish without a single percent of chicory.

No filler. No roasted root. Just coffee.

I keep a jar on my desk for the 3 PM reset. One spoon, hot water, fifteen seconds. The aroma hits before the cup reaches my lips.

What does your afternoon coffee actually taste like?

Purista — freeze-dried Gourmet Robusta granules, zero chicory, bold yet smooth with locked-in aroma and natural crema.
Purica — freeze-dried pure Arabica granules, zero chicory, smooth with caramel and chocolatey notes.
Ultra Blend — 70% coffee, 30% chicory, agglomerated, a smooth everyday milk coffee that hits right every time.

₹877 delivered (free shipping above ₹399). That's ₹219 saved versus buying separately.

No sample sachets. Just four real jars you can line up, taste side by side, and finally agree on.

Try this tomorrow: water at ~85°C, one level spoon per cup, let it bloom for 30 seconds before stirring. You'll taste the difference immediately.
